# identity.PlatformStaff

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A platform staff member; access also requires MFA (SP1 spec §3.4).

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `identity.PlatformStaff` |
| Kind | `entity` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `platform` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `createdAt` | yes | `none` | When the staff record was created (UTC). |  |
| `isActive` | yes | `none` | Inactive staff hold no platform permission. |  |
| `role` | yes | `none` | Staff role. |  |
| `uid` | yes | `personal` | Firebase Auth uid of the staff member (document id). |  |
| `updatedAt` | yes | `none` | When the staff record last changed (UTC). |  |
